vetSays.line: 🛡️ Jae, Courtney, Leo, Sofia and Victor met them at the door — 5 put down. Jae, Courtney, Leo, Sofia, Victor are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ishaan taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Ishaan drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🛡️ Jae, Tashi, Sofia, Fatima and Victor met them at the door — 5 put down. Jae, Tashi, Sofia, Fatima, Victor are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Jae, Courtney, Tashi and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Jae, Courtney, Tashi, Sofia are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Jae strikes the Elder Big Big.
The Elder Big Big falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Big Big!
📺 You brought down Elder Big Big. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Big Big.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Courtney just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jae, Courtney, Leo, Sofia and Fatima met them at the door — 5 put down. Jae, Courtney, Leo, Sofia, Fatima are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jae, Tashi, Leo, Sofia and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jae, Tashi, Leo, Sofia, Fatima are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ishaan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
Tashi: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Marcus met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nyachae just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Samin and Nyachae met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Samin is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
